title: Production incident: connection pool exhaustion on core-api
description: core-api started returning 502s under normal traffic. Investigation showed PostgreSQL connections were maxed out. Root cause and fix needed.

comments.author: lin
comments.text: Confirmed via pg_stat_activity that a background report-export view was opening a connection and holding it for the full duration of a large CSV export instead of streaming, sometimes for 10+ minutes.

comments.author: lin
comments.text: Short term: lowered CONN_MAX_AGE and added a dedicated smaller connection pool for the export endpoint so it can't starve the main pool.

comments.author: oncall-lead
comments.text: Good catch. Let's also add an alert on pg connection count so we see this before it pages customers next time.

implementation_notes: Rewrote the CSV export view to stream rows with server-side cursors (queryset.iterator()) instead of loading the full queryset, and moved it to a separate PgBouncer pool with a low max size so a runaway export can't exhaust connections available to normal request traffic. Added a CloudWatch alarm on RDS DatabaseConnections.
resolution: Deployed streaming export + isolated connection pool. Incident did not recur over the following month. Alarm added to catch early warning signs.
